A traditional freshener relies on the strength of the artificial fragrance it contains to hide odors. Instead of removing odors, it blends them with the unpleasant smell of chemicals. The outer layer of PURGGO is made of hemp because of its significantly lower environmental impact in comparison to cotton. Hemp, like bamboo, grows without needing any pesticide. It's a nutrient-rich natural fertilizer suitable for the garden, lawn, and flowerbeds. Life has a way of springing nasty surprises on us. The situation gets even worse when your allergies flare up or you have an asthma attack. But it was worth it—at least you got rid of the smell! A careful sniff reveals…the delightful bouquet of artificial pine mixed with onions and wet dog. In defeated frustration, you realize that this odor is even worse. Nooooo...!
